beats.event: Athena rouses Telemachus; Odysseus still held captive by Calypso.
Telemachus at Nestor; hears of Agamemnon's fatal homecoming.
Menelaus confirms Odysseus alive but Calypso's prisoner.
Zeus orders release; Odysseus builds raft, leaves Ogygia.
Poseidon wrecks raft; Ino saves him; washed naked to Scheria.
Nausicaa finds him; welcomed at Alcinous's palace.
Honored at Phaeacian games; weeps at bard's Troy songs.
Flashback: blinds Polyphemus the Cyclops; crew escapes.
Aeolus's wind-bag opened by crew; blown back to sea.
Laestrygonian giants sink all ships but his own.
Circe turns men to pigs; moly saves them; year on Aeaea.
Underworld: Tiresias's grim prophecy; meets mother's shade.
Scylla eats six; men slay Helios's cattle; Zeus sinks last ship.
Phaeacians ferry him home; wakes on Ithaca's shore.
Disguised as beggar; sheltered by loyal swineherd Eumaeus.
Reveals himself to Telemachus; they plot revenge.
Mocked by suitors in his hall; old dog Argos dies knowing him.
Strings the great bow no suitor could bend.
Slaughters the suitors; reclaims his household.
Reunites with Penelope via the olive-tree bed test.
Reveals himself to Laertes; Athena imposes peace.
